metadata.title: Dated, falsifiable, model-conditional forecasts for DESI Year-5 and Euclid DR1 (12 November 2026 pack)
metadata.description: Dated, falsifiable, model-conditional cosmology forecasts by C.A.S.D.R, recorded on 12 November 2026 (America/Toronto). Euclid DR1-Foundation (12 November 2026) only timestamps these forecasts. The galaxy-clustering and weak-lensing products needed for the strongest tests are scheduled for mid-2027 (DR1 Complete); today's Foundation release does not supply those measurements. The pack ranks prospective forecasts and clearly labelled conditional theory curves for (i) the first Euclid spectroscopic BAO distances DM/rd and DH/rd at z = 0.9, 1.2, 1.5 and 1.8, to be scored against a measurement built on Euclid DR1 Complete (mid-2027 or later), and (ii) DESI DR3 / Year-5 BAO cosmology results expected in 2027, plus one SH0ES H0 range. Foundation covers about 1,900 square degrees (catalogue-level); no full-mission precision is applied to it. Distance grid entries are not independent predictions. Where a sound-horizon integral truncation had held a BAO+CMB row, this pack uses an R03 revision labelled “R03-recomputed (r_s integral corrected)”; frozen originals are untouched and are not quoted. Wording is prospective, model-conditional. This metadata file is a draft for Zenodo and OSF; nothing has been uploaded.
